attack1_geometric_hodge.result: Aut(W33)-invariant edge metric is unique up to scale and the 24D spherical normalization makes every clique-line a regular tetrahedron with positive circumcentric weights.
attack1_geometric_hodge.boundary: The clique complex is non-manifold: each triangle has one tetrahedral coface and vertex duals are branched. This is a positive piecewise-Euclidean circumcentric Hodge metric, not a smooth 3-manifold triangulation.

attack2_full_similitude_unitaries.minimality: dim >= q(q-1) because determinant acts transitively on all q-1 nontrivial central characters and Stone-von Neumann gives an inequivalent q-dimensional Schrodinger irrep for each; the construction attains the bound.
attack2_full_similitude_unitaries.q3_contrast: q(q-1)=2q only at q=3, so the ordinary conjugate pair is already the full central-character completion only there.

attack3_kramers_e8.proposed_square: A=T^2 is +I on g0 and -I on g1+g2
attack3_kramers_e8.result: The doubled T^2=-1 operator cannot be a Lie automorphism or anti-automorphism of the exact E8 bracket. It may only be imposed as a separate state-space/Hamiltonian symmetry. The certified J^2=+1 real involution remains bracket-compatible.

attack5_profile_likelihood.result: For the stated nuisance model the earlier N=128 design is conservative; N=87 is the exact first detected-event count in 60..100 where both worst three-sigma-box tails fall below one-sided 5-sigma alpha.
